summary: Convert filenames to bytes with to_bytes when touching the filesystem; pure string manipulation can stay text, but never mix bytes and text in calls like os.path.join.
questions: Should I pass bytes or text filenames to os functions?
Why does os.path.join raise a TypeError in my code?

answer_card.title: Filesystem interaction
answer_card.answer_md:
Filesystem calls: convert to bytes.
```python
f = open(to_bytes(filename), 'wb')
mtime = os.path.getmtime(to_bytes(filename))
```
Pure string ops (`os.path.join(u'/var/tmp/café', u'くらとみ')`) can stay text. **Never mix** bytes and text in one call; it raises tracebacks.
